_doc: Hand-checked building facts that win over OSM tags. Only values with a public source. Match by OSM id ("osm": "w123"/"r123") or by name when no id is given. floors = storeys above ground; h = metres to roof. colour/material/roof/roofColour use OSM building:colour / building:material / roof:shape / roof:colour values. facade = window style in js/map.js (campus, glass, concrete, wash, arcade). feature = named extras drawn by js/map.js. split = cut the footprint into blocks: cuts[i] = [[x,z],[x,z]] (block 0 lies left of cut 0 seen from its first point), floors per block. Colours and materials judged from the photos listed (viewed only; nothing from them is used as a texture, all textures are generated in js/map.js).

buildings.name: 知行領航館
buildings.note: 3F+B1, 5,471 m2 floor area, opened 2019, address 新中北路499號 (all per the source page). Not matched yet: OSM has no footprint named 知行領航館. Checked 2026-11: no unnamed OSM footprint within 90 m of 新中北路 east of the 465號 7-Eleven is large enough (5,471 m2 over 4 storeys needs ~1,300 m2; the largest is 735 m2), so build_map prints 'override not matched' until an OSM id is added as "osm".

buildings.name: 全人教育村
buildings.note: Official: 北棟 6F, 中棟 5F, 南棟 9F, B1 parking. The OSM way is one footprint (OSM tags 7F / 24.5 m); it is cut along its notch at z=-100 and along the diagonal of the joint (-19.3,-81.1)-(-11.5,-80.3) (a straight cut at z=-81 left a 0.8 m wide 9F strip beside the east wing) into the north bar, the east connecting wing and the south block, which are taken as 北/中/南棟 by position (assumption: the source names the blocks but has no plan). Colour: light greyish beige walls in the Commons photo.

buildings.name: 懷恩樓
buildings.note: M+ catalogue text: beige building, flat roof, a horizontal block with arches on both levels. Commons photos: continuous round arches on both storeys, light tan face-brick tiles. Floors stay at OSM building:levels=2.

buildings.name: 張靜愚紀念圖書館
buildings.note: Official: exterior tiles restored in 2014 to the original design; three dome skylights over 修德廳 (1F) and a sunken garden. Photos: grey-brown small brick-format tiles, horizontal window bands. The skylights and sunken garden are not modelled: no source gives their position on the footprint. Floors stay at OSM 5F.

buildings.name: 科學館
buildings.note: Photo: red-brown brick-tile facade, observatory dome on the roof. The dome's spot on the roof is approximate (placed at the roof centre).

buildings.name: 工學館
buildings.note: Photo (titled 工學院): light beige tiles with a glazed stair core.

buildings.name: 電學大樓
buildings.note: Photo of the College of EECS building (the college is housed in 電學大樓): dark brown tiles, green-tinted windows.

buildings.name: 維澈樓

buildings.name: 學生活動中心
source: https://oosa.cycu.edu.tw/wp-content/uploads/中原大學活動中心管理細則-1100414.doc.pdf
buildings.note: Photos: white square tiles, colonnade along the ground floor. Colour/material only: the footprint, the McDonald's interior on its east side and the B1 open-air amphitheatre (management rules PDF) are left as they are.

buildings.name: 恩惠堂
buildings.note: Photos: white walls, steep pitched roof with grey eaves, white spire with a cross (spire not modelled: its position is not clear from the photos). Floors stay at the estimate (no source).

buildings.name: 中原大學體育館
buildings.note: M+ catalogue text: flat roof with a pitched section, glass exterior on one side. Height stays at OSM height=10m (no source for another value). The pitched section is drawn over the middle of the roof (its exact extent is not in the source); the glass side is not modelled (side unknown).

buildings.name: 望樓
buildings.note: OSM says levels=3 but height=21 (7 m per floor). The photo shows three storeys, so levels win (10.5 m). White tiles.

buildings.name: 土木館
buildings.note: Photo: grey granite-chip render (洗石子 look). Floors stay at OSM levels=5; OSM height=28 (5.6 m per floor) is not used, the photo does not show the whole height.

鐘塔.note: Photos: two slender fair-faced concrete pylons joined at the top, a bell hung between them and a cross on top; no clock faces, no brick. Height has no written source: the total (19 m pylons + 5 m cross) is kept close to the old model (24.8 m). OSM node 4845066050 man_made=tower, alt_name=二一鐘.

舊校門.note: Photo Cycu_gate.jpg (described 中原大學校門): three white concrete round arches side by side on twin columns, with the characters 中原大學 on plaques. The current main gate (CYCU_Gate_New.jpg) is a twisted metal sculpture, so the arches are taken to be the old gate. INFERENCE, not verified: the photo caption only says 中原大學校門 (uploaded 2011) and names neither 舊校門 nor this POI's position; no history page or news item describing the old gate was found (searched 2026-11). Sizes (~21 m wide, 5.6 m arch span) have no written source and are estimates (the road passes under the middle arch).
